description: NaCrO₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.34 Å. Cr³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. All Cr-O bond lengths are 2.02 Å. O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Cr³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Cr₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
